evals.prompt: Generate a programmatic SEO keyword strategy for the business described in sample-prd.md. Target the top 10 US cities for tech companies. Create all deliverables.
expectations: Creates keyword-universe.csv with at least 100 keywords
CSV includes all required columns: keyword, service, location, intent_modifier, cluster_type, priority_score
Generates at least 3 landing page templates
Creates seo-strategy.md with implementation roadmap
Includes competitor analysis with web search results
Keywords combine service (compliance/SOC2/HIPAA) + location + intent modifiers
Templates include {{variable}} placeholders for dynamic content
Priority scores are calculated and sorted descending

evals.prompt: Using sample-prd.md, create landing page templates for compliance software targeting healthcare companies in major cities. Focus on template quality and SEO optimization.
expectations: Templates include proper SEO metadata (title, meta description)
Each template has clear {{variable}} definitions
Templates include schema.org markup examples
Local elements present (city-specific content suggestions)
CTA sections are clear and actionable
Templates avoid thin content with minimum length guidance
Industry-specific customization evident for healthcare vertical

evals.prompt: Research competitor SEO strategies for compliance automation software in San Francisco, Austin, and New York. Generate keyword opportunities based on SERP gaps.
expectations: Uses web_search to research actual competitors
Documents SERP intent patterns (what page types rank)
Identifies content gaps or opportunities
competitor-analysis.md file created with findings
Recommendations based on actual search results, not assumptions
Notes specific competitor strengths/weaknesses
Validates at least 5-10 keyword patterns with live searches

evals.prompt: Create keyword universe for all compliance frameworks mentioned in sample-prd.md (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI). Target top 5 cities.
expectations: Keywords cover all 5 frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI)
Service dimension includes framework-specific terms
At least 150 total keywords across all frameworks
Cluster types include framework comparison keywords
Priority scoring accounts for different framework popularity
Templates adaptable across different frameworks

evals.prompt: Generate programmatic SEO strategy specifically for healthcare and fintech industries mentioned in the PRD. Include vertical-specific landing pages.
expectations: Keywords include industry modifiers (for healthcare, for fintech)
Vertical-specific template created
Industry pain points from PRD incorporated into templates
Keyword clusters organized by industry vertical
Regulatory context specific to healthcare (HIPAA) and fintech (PCI) highlighted
Industry-specific case study placeholders in templates
